## Design and release review

- [ ] This change is bounded to one visual or interaction goal.
- [ ] The live baseline was left unchanged while the work was developed.
- [ ] Source content and deployed public content were both checked where applicable.
- [ ] The smallest supported phone width and a wide viewport were reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant states were checked, including long content and empty or unavailable states.
- [ ] Before and after screenshots are attached for visual changes.
- [ ] `npm run check-publish` passes.
- [ ] `npm run check-design` passes.
- [ ] Unrelated files are not included.
- [ ] The rollback commit or release point is known.

## Notes

Describe the intended visual result, the states reviewed, and any deliberate responsive behavior.
